name: xray-extension
description: > A production-grade browser extension that auto-intercepts API calls, auto-decrypts encrypted responses, and displays clean JSON in a world-class visualizer panel. Built for **Chrome & Edge** (Manifest V3).

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
scripts.package:extension: npm run check && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-extension.ps1
